obligations.stimulus: Apply active-low synchronous reset and run the complete CPU/ROM/RAM after legal deassertion; cover state reset and restart, legal PROGRAM_FILE/built-in programs, and address ranges. Deterministic RAM expectations require writing before reading. The specific number of software files and reset cycles is not restricted.
obligations.expected: clk advances on the rising edge; rst is an active-low synchronous reset. One active reset edge clears the fetch address, fetched instruction, execute token, writeback token, and eight general-purpose registers to zero; result_valid, result_data, and the peripheral read-hold state are cleared to zero. Data RAM is not initialized and is not cleared by reset; reads of addresses that have never been written are undefined. Legal deterministic data expectations require writing before reading. Instruction ROM is initialized to zero, then the words covered by PROGRAM_FILE are loaded; addresses are 10-bit word addresses and wrap modulo 1024. ROM does not change on reset. The file may use readmemh address markers; only known 16-bit data words constitute a legal program.

obligations.checker: Independent prediction from input history, actual comparison, mismatch reporting, and evidence of non-vacuous activity.

obligations.expected: The first five bits being 8 indicate LOAD, with destination [10:8] and address register [2:0]; the first five bits being 10 indicate STORE, with address register [10:8] and data register [2:0]. obligations.stimulus: Vary input_data and read it at different LOAD execution edges; observe the single-cycle valid of result STORE, data holding, 0x3ff readback, and the lack of a result effect from writing 0x3fe. The actual stimulus must distinguish synchronous capture from combinational feedthrough.
obligations.expected: The edge executing a LOAD at address 0x3fe samples input_data; reading 0x3ff obtains the pre-edge result_data. Both peripherals and RAM use synchronous reads with holding; consecutive switches between the two read sources must use the newly sampled source, and must not allow input_data to pass combinationally through to writeback. When executing a STORE at address 0x3ff and not performing a read operation, result_valid is set to 1 for one cycle after that edge, and result_data registers the store data; on every subsequent edge that is not a result write, result_valid is set to 0, while result_data holds until the next result write or reset. Writing 0x3fe does not change the result and does not write RAM. input_data may change on every falling clock edge; the sampling time is determined by the actual LOAD execution edge.

obligations.stimulus: Cover absolute/relative and conditional/unconditional branches, including taken/not-taken cases for negative, nonnegative, zero, and nonzero conditions; use public results to distinguish targets, offset truncation, and flushing of younger tokens, with no delay slot.
obligations.expected: The first four bits 8 indicate JMP, with the absolute address coming from register [2:0]; 9 indicates JMPR, with the relative offset being the signed six-bit number in [5:0]. The first four bits 10 indicate a conditional absolute jump, and 11 a conditional relative jump. Condition code [11:9]: 0 means the register value is negative, 1 means nonnegative, 2 means zero, and 3 means nonzero; other conditions do not jump. The tested register is [8:6], and the absolute target register is [2:0]. Comparisons use signed 32-bit values. The absolute target retains the low 10 bits; the relative target is the fetch address before the execution edge plus sign_extend(offset)−2, finally retaining the low 10 bits. There are no separate condition flags and no delay slots. A taken jump clears the two younger tokens; otherwise the pipeline advances normally.

obligations.setup: Establish the legal history required for this obligation through the native public interface, satisfying public initialization and deterministic valid windows, without accessing hidden state.
obligations.stimulus: Construct observable data dependencies, LOAD stalls, execution/writeback bypass conflicts, and post-branch histories; check MMIO and the first execution after reset according to execution cycles, rather than checking only result order.
obligations.expected:
To specify MMIO cycles precisely, abstract the pipeline as fetch address P, fetched instruction I, execute token X, and writeback token W. At each edge, first compute the execution value, memory transaction, and jump from pre-edge X, obtain the writeback value from pre-edge W, and read the register operands of I. For each operand of a non-NOP instruction, if the execution destination matches, preferentially use the current execution value; otherwise, if the writeback destination matches, use the current writeback value; otherwise read the pre-edge register. The current execution value of LOAD is zero; NOP does not use bypassing.

Without a stall, the edge places ROM[P] into I, I and the operands above into X, and the opcode/destination/result of X into W, increments P by one, and writes pre-edge W into the registers. The LOAD execution edge holds P and I, inserts an all-zero bubble into X, and still passes LOAD into W normally; thus, on the next edge, I uses LOAD writeback bypassing. A taken branch sets the new P to the target and clears I/X to zero, while W still receives the branch. Reset takes priority over these changes. MMIO is sampled or issued on the execution edge of X and must not be delayed until the register writeback edge. After reset, the first instruction ROM[0] enters I on the first edge with reset released, enters X on the second edge, and executes on the third edge.

obligations.checker: Independent prediction from input history, actual comparison, mismatch reporting, and evidence of non-vacuous activity.

obligations.setup: Establish the legal history required for this obligation through the native public interface, satisfying public initialization and deterministic valid windows, without accessing hidden state.
obligations.stimulus: Write and consume R0, then pass tokens without data results, such as NOP/STORE/branches, through execution/writeback, observing default R0 zeroing and the associated bypassing; do not use a permanently zero R0 as the expectation.
obligations.expected: All eight registers, including R0, can be written by instructions with data results. Every non-reset edge unconditionally writes the destination and value of W into the registers: arithmetic, logic, shifts, and LOADC use their destination/result; LOAD uses its destination/synchronous read value; other opcodes default to destination R0 and value zero. Thus NOP, STORE, branches, and so on clear R0 when they reach writeback. Execution bypassing likewise provides the default destination R0 and zero value for instructions with no data result; R0 must not be tied to zero, nor may non-writing instructions be assumed to have no register side effects at all.
obligations.sampling: Explicitly distinguish the input acceptance edge, pre-edge state, and post-edge stable outputs; correctly delimit valid windows.
obligations.checker: Independent prediction from input history, actual comparison, mismatch reporting, and evidence of non-vacuous activity.

obligations.stimulus: Run to HALT and maintain a history long enough to observe potential subsequent transactions; check the public outputs resulting from P/I/X/W holding, valid clearing to zero, data holding, and reset restart. No fixed number of trailing cycles or repetition of the same test for every software program is required.
obligations.expected: The first four bits 12 indicate HALT. Once X contains HALT, P/I/X/W all hold, and subsequent instructions do not execute; the registers still repeatedly write the held W on every edge. result_valid is computed according to whether a result STORE exists on that edge; HALT itself has no memory transaction, so it becomes zero, while result_data holds. Another synchronous reset can start the program. Verification must be able to observe multiple results produced by the program and their corresponding times; a single result of the default firmware adding four to the input must not be used to represent the entire legal ISA, software domain, or stall behavior.
